chunks: Hadith 2413 — The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “No man leaves his family under a guardianship better than two rakʿahs that he performs when he intends to depart on his journey
and says: ‘O Allah, I entrust to You my soul, my family, my wealth, my offspring, my worldly life, my Hereafter, my trust, and the final outcome of my deeds.’
No one says that except that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, grants him what he asked for.”

key_terms.أَسْتَوْدِعُكَ: I entrust to Your protection and care
key_terms.أَمَانَتِي: that which has been entrusted to me; my trust
key_terms.خَاتِمَةَ عَمَلِي: the final end and conclusion of my deeds
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيْنِ: two units of salat (prayer) performed before departure

ai.seo_question: What supplication and prayer should be recited before leaving for a journey?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a recommended practice for one setting out on a journey: to perform two rakʿahs and then entrust oneself and all one cares about to Allah. It emphasizes reliance upon Allah in travel, protection for one’s family and affairs, and seeking a good ending in one’s deeds.
